class.name: ThemeDB
class.brief_description: A singleton that provides access to static information about [Theme] resources used by the engine and by your project.
class.description: This singleton provides access to static information about [Theme] resources used by the engine and by your projects. You can fetch the default engine theme, as well as your project configured theme. [ThemeDB] also contains fallback values for theme properties.

method.name: add_user_icon
method.description:
Add an Icon to the default theme, which will make it change colors and scale when the default theme is changed from [ProjectSettings]. [param icon_source] should be a valid SVG [String]. In SVG source "red" and "#0f0" are replaced with font and accent colors when they are changed from [ProjectSettings]. [b]Note:[/b] Editor plugins need to remove their user icon(s) when unloaded. [codeblock] func _enter_tree(): var source = FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://icon.svg") ThemeDB.add_user_icon("my_icon", source)
func _exit_tree(): ThemeDB.remove_user_icon("my_icon") [/codeblock]

method.name: freeze_default_theme
method.description: Prevents the default theme from emitting changed. This prevents Nodes using the theme from being updated until [method unfreeze_default_theme] is called.

method.name: get_default_theme
method.description: Returns a reference to the default engine [Theme]. This theme resource is responsible for the out-of-the-box look of [Control] nodes and cannot be overridden.

method.name: get_icon
method.description: Returns an internal icon from the fallback theme, internal theme icons are the default icons that comes with Blazium.

method.name: get_icon_list
method.description: Returns a list for all the icon names that are used internally for the default theme.

method.name: get_project_theme
method.description: Returns a reference to the custom project [Theme]. This theme resources allows to override the default engine theme for every control node in the project. To set the project theme, see [member ProjectSettings.gui/theme/custom].

method.name: get_user_icon
method.description: Returns a user icon from the default theme.

method.name: get_user_icon_list
method.description: Returns a list for all the user icon names.

method.name: has_icon
method.description: Returns whether the default theme has an internal icon with [param icon_name].

method.name: has_user_icon
method.description: Returns whether the default theme has a user icon with [param icon_name].

method.name: is_default_theme_frozen
method.description: Returns whether the default theme is frozen.

method.name: remove_user_icon
method.description: Removes a user icon that was previously added to the default theme.

method.name: unfreeze_default_theme
method.description: Emits [signal Resource.changed] if the default theme was already frozen. Also check [method freeze_default_theme].

members.member: The fallback base scale factor of every [Control] node and [Theme] resource. Used when no other value is available to the control. See also [member Theme.default_base_scale].
The fallback font of every [Control] node and [Theme] resource. Used when no other value is available to the control. See also [member Theme.default_font].
The fallback font size of every [Control] node and [Theme] resource. Used when no other value is available to the control. See also [member Theme.default_font_size].
The fallback icon of every [Control] node and [Theme] resource. Used when no other value is available to the control. Internal theme icons are the default icons that comes with Blazium.
The fallback stylebox of every [Control] node and [Theme] resource. Used when no other value is available to the control.

signal.name: fallback_changed
signal.description: Emitted when one of the fallback values had been changed. Use it to refresh the look of controls that may rely on the fallback theme items.
